hero.title: Widening access to quality, inclusive education
hero.subtitle: Keeping children in school and learning, especially girls and the most vulnerable.

challenge.heading: The Challenge
challenge.text: Conflict, displacement and poverty keep many children in South Sudan out of school or in classrooms without trained teachers, learning materials or safe facilities. Girls, children with disabilities and displaced children are most likely to miss out, and hunger at home pulls children away from learning.

items.title: Access & retention
items.description: removing barriers for the most marginalised.

items.title: Teaching quality
items.description: strengthening teachers and providing learning materials.

currentWork.heading: What We Are Doing Now
items: Scholarship placements via Bridge2Rwanda (37 scholars to date).
Teacher training at Arizona State University (15 teachers).
Solar electrification of Juba Girls and Nimule Model Secondary Schools.
School supplies and community engagement activities.
